title: Inspect a table definition
summary: PRAGMA table_info shows facts about a table's columns.
introduction: PRAGMA table_info shows facts about a table's columns. Your task: Find which output row marks message as required.
learningObjectives: Find which output row marks message as required.
Explain the example for inspect a table definition

blocks.text: PRAGMA table_info shows facts about a table's columns. It can help you check the names and declared types your query needs.
Use the SQL Run button for examples marked runnable. They use this site's in-browser SQLite database and sample-only table names. A Python example needs Python on your own computer instead.

blocks.title: Inspect a table definition

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A primary key identifies a row and prevents duplicate key values. Related records can refer to that key.
`NOT NULL` requires a value to be present. It is a separate rule from numeric range checks.
`PRAGMA` is SQLite's command family for connection settings or inspection. Check the specific pragma's effect.

blocks.text: The result lists id and message with their types and column flags.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: This is SQLite-specific inspection syntax. Another database tool may use a different command.

blocks.text: Find which output row marks message as required.
